cards.audioText: [Your call-sign is UAL221, a flight from Los Angeles to Wuhan. Now you are leveling at 10100m on airway R343 with squawk 4123, contact Shanghai Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是美联航221，一架从洛杉矶飞往武汉的航班。你现在在航路R343上平飞，高度10100米，应答机4123，联系上海区调。】
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, UAL221, leveling at 10100m on airway R343, squawk 4123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海区调，美联航221，在航路R343上平飞，高度10100米，应答机4123。

cards.audioText: C: UAL221, Shanghai Control, radar contact, reduce speed to Mach decimal eight one.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 美联航221，上海区调，雷达看见了，速度减小至马赫数点81。
cards.referenceText: Reduce speed to Mach decimal eight one, UAL221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 速度减小至马赫数点81，美联航221。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL221, one of the BBJs operated by Air China is at your 10 O’clock, climb to 11300m, report reaching.
[Tell controller that your aircraft is too heavy to climb to 11300m.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 美联航221，一架国航的BBJ（波音公务机）在你10点钟方向，上到11300米，到达后报。
【告诉管制员，你的飞机太重了，无法上到11300米。】
cards.referenceTextZh: 不能，由于重量，无法上到11300米，美联航221。

cards.audioText: C: UAL221, roger, then turn right heading 280, descend to and maintain 9500m, expedite your rate of descent.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 美联航221，收到，那么右转航向280，下到9500米保持，加速下降。
cards.referenceText: Right heading 280, descend to and maintain 9500m, wilco, UAL221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向280，下到9500米保持，照办，美联航221。

cards.audioText: [As you are leveling at 9500m, you encounter severe turbulence. You have a rapid airspeed decay due turbulence, so you want to descend immediately to a lower level.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【当你在9500米平飞时，你遇到了强颠簸。由于颠簸，空速快速下降，因此你想立刻下降到更低高度。】
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, UAL221, leveling at 9500m, we encounter turbulence and our airspeed decreases rapidly, request immediate descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海区调，美联航221，在9500米平飞，我们遇到了颠簸，我们的空速快速下降，请求立刻下降。

cards.audioText: C: UAL221, descend to 8100m, report reaching.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 美联航221，下到8100米，到达后报。

cards.audioText: C: UAL221, radar service terminated, contact Wuhan Control on 125.3.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 美联航221，雷达服务终止，联系武汉区调125.3。

cards.audioText: [You are now leveling at 8100m, next waypoint P344. A rear cabin crew reported an old man suffers from heart attack, and he is having difficulty breathing. For safety concerns, you want to divert to Hefei airport, inform Wuhan Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你现在在8100米平飞，下一个航路点是P344，后舱一名乘务员报告说一名老年人心脏病犯了，他现在呼吸困难。出于安全考虑，你想改航到合肥机场，告知武汉区调。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL221, 8100m maintaining, next P344, an old man suffers from heart attack, and he is having difficulty breathing. Request divert to Hefei.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，美联航221，正保持在8100米，下一航路点P344，一名老年人心脏病犯了，他现在呼吸困难，请求改航到合肥机场。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL221, Wuhan Control, roger, maintain present heading and descend to 7200m. Advise the detailed information and the severity of the passenger.
[Tell Wuhan Control that the sick passenger is about 60 years old, sitting in seat 35A. He takes medicine with him, and the cabin crew is offering first aid.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 美联航221，武汉区调，收到，保持当前航向，下到7200米。告知乘客的详细信息以及病情严重性。
【告知武汉区调，乘客大概60岁，坐在35A。他携带了药物，客舱乘务员正在提供急救。】
cards.referenceText: Maintain present heading and descend to 7200m. The sick passenger is about 60 years old, sitting in seat 35A. He takes medicine with him, and the cabin crew is offering first aid, UAL221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持当前航向，下到7200米。乘客大概60岁，坐在35A。他携带了药物，客舱乘务员正在进行急救。

cards.audioText: C: UAL221, roger that. Further descend to 6300m, and let us know the development of the onboard situation.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 美联航221，收到。继续下到6300米，让我们知晓机上的发展情况。

cards.audioText: [Inform Wuhan Control that after receiving the first aid by the cabin crew, the sick passenger’s condition has improved and he is now conscious. Therefore, you no longer require the diversion, you want to continue to your destination Wuhan.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【告知武汉区调，乘务员提供了急救之后，乘客情况好多了，恢复了意识。因此，你不再需要改航，你想继续飞往你的目的地武汉。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL221, the sick passenger is conscious after the first aid, request cancel diversion and continue to Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，美联航221，经过急救，乘客现在恢复意识，请求取消调改航，继续飞往武汉机场。

cards.audioText: C: UAL221, Wuhan Control, roger, you can still continue to your original airport Wuhan, descend to 4500m, and expect ILS approach runway 04R.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 美联航221，武汉区调，收到，你可以继续飞往你的原计划武汉机场，下到4500米，预计盲降进近跑道04右。
cards.referenceText: Original airport, descend to 4500m, ILS approach runway 04R, UAL221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 原机场，下到4500米，盲降进近跑道04右，美联航221。

cards.audioText: [You are now on long final runway 04R, about 7nm from touchdown, request your landing clearance from Wuhan Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你现在在04右跑道长五边，距离接地点大概7海里，向武汉塔台申请着陆许可。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL221, long final runway 04R, about 7nm from touchdown, request landing clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，美联航221，跑道04右长五边，接地点大概7海里，请求着陆许可。

cards.audioText: C: UAL221, Wuhan Tower, roger, you are cleared to land, runway 04R, wind 240 degrees 18 knots.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 美联航221，武汉塔台，收到，可以落地，跑道04右，风240度，18节。
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以落地，跑道04右，美联航221。

cards.audioText: [Because the sick passenger is seating near the door number two on the left side (L2), you want to open that door when you arrive at the gate and let medical staff help to deplane that passenger, inform controller.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【由于受伤乘客坐在左2门附近，你想在到达机位的时候打开此门，让医疗人员协助乘客下飞机，告知管制员。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL221, request open the door number two on the left side (L2) and let medical staff help to deplane that passenger.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，美联航221，请求打开左2门，让医疗人员协助乘客下飞机。

cards.audioText: C: UAL221, Wuhan Tower, roger, you can open that door and we have delivered your message to the medical staff that are standing by.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 美联航221，武汉塔台，收到，你可以打开此门，我们已经将你的信息告知正在等待的医疗人员。
